title: Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States, Part II, Vol. II
author: Sir J. George Scott & J. P. Hardiman
genre: Colonial Gazetteer & Ethnography of Shan States
description: Comprehensive colonial gazetteer compiled from official government papers and surveys, detailing the geography, topography, administrative subdivisions, town gazetteers, and tribal populations of the Southern Shan States, including Kengtung, Mong Nai, and neighboring Tai regions along the Salween and Mekong river basins.

sentences.free_translation_en: This volume constitutes the second part of the authoritative Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States.
